compatibility: Recommender bundles, classical pipeline bundles, Torch trainer bundles, RAG bundles, TDA bundles, and Session checkpoints are complementary, not interchangeable. A recommender bundle (buildml.recommender_bundle.v1) stores a train-fitted RecommenderPlan (user/item catalog, interaction matrix, similarities or factors). A Session checkpoint stores data, roles, splits, history, and optional classical preprocess plans; it does not embed the recommender. Reload tabular workflow via checkpoint_load; reload the recommender via load_recommender_bundle. Honesty: Session CF + optional content — not a Netflix-scale platform; distinct from RAG retrieve/generate and from EDA Recommendation Findings.
